From Little Feet · Your stand's blows shrink whatever they hit.

Theme Affliction

  • 1: When your stand hits with a Strike, target attempts @Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude}: failure, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 1} until the end of your next turn; critical failure, also shrinks one size.
  • 5: Critical failure makes the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 2}.
  • 9: Surge: shrink yourself and your stand to Tiny for 10 minutes (+2 Stealth, can squeeze through any gap).
  • 13: Shrinking now lasts 1 minute and stacks once more on a later hit (up to two sizes).
  • 17: A creature that fails while already shrunk becomes Tiny and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 3} for 1 minute (incapacitation).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
